name: Records request preparation check
summary: When a request for copies of records arrives, the records officer gets a checklist: what the request asks for, what the supplied authorization documents say, who the copies would go to, each set against the practice's own release procedure, with every gap listed. A person decides what, if anything, is released.

sources.title: Fully Powered AI's published map of the work of preparing a request for copies of records: comparing the stated scope, the supplied authorization and the requested recipient with the practice's own release procedure, and handing the gaps to the people who decide.
